reviews.text: Highly recommend Whitestone Dog House! Boarded my Morkie for 2 weeks while vacationing in Europe. I went with the Platinum package, which included various perks. Mike, the owner and all his staff were wonderful and gave my pup the best time! Also put me at ease keeping in communication with me, alongside sending pics and videos of my furry friend. Whitestone Dog House is the way to go!!!
It’s 95 degrees and there is a poor dog barking outside.

All the one star reviews are well deserved. I’ve personally been going to this groomer for 3-4 years & have encountered everything these people have mentioned, discrimination, prejudice & abuse on my furry friend. One day when I came to pick my best friend the man at the front desk was saying that I could go in the back to get her, at first I thought this was strange because like I stated I’ve been going to this groomers for at least 2 years at the time. But I figured “oh okay”, since I been a loyal member for so long it wasn’t a big deal” turns out my pet wasn’t coming out the cage because she was scared. This let me know immediately that my friend has been abused or mistreated in some way, when I spoke about this w/ my mother she said maybe I was just overthinking it so I let it go.. fast forward to her next appointment, when I picked her up everything was good she was excited to see me but I noticed she wouldn’t sit up straight at first I was thinking okay maybe she’s a little tired because it was like 98 degrees this day. Once I got home I noticed she couldn’t even walk… took her to the vet & the vet said someone put too much pressure on her lower back messing up her spine. Please if you value your pets health do not take them here!!

They're very good with my dogs. The owner and staff is very friendly. My dog's head stayed for 2 weeks and they sent me videos every day.
And I'm very happy with their groomers

We take our dog here because they are professional and courteous here. Each person ive met here are absolute animal lovers and treat them with care. Ive seen big dog to small dogs come in and out of this shop. Only downside is, theyre on a busy street and parking is tough to find sometimes. This place is worth the hassle.  5 out of 5

I brought my 7 yr old baby girl in today for her first grooming and I am soooo happy with the service! Not only was the owner Mike and the groomer Matt super nice and helpful but my baby girl came out smelling amazing and looking cuter than I could have ever imagined! And thinner too after her much needed deshedding. Lol I can't wait to bring her back and check out their boarding services as the reviews I've read have been nothing but positive. And knowing that they have a good relationship with her Vet's office truly makes me feel that much more comfortable. 🤗

As always they do an amazing job on my Bella!
Moved into the neighborhood last year and swear by them since! My dogs coat is looking healthier and healthier each day!

I recently used Whitestone Dog House for both training and boarding for my two munchkins, I couldn't be happier with the exceptional care they had received!
Patience & Expertise: Mike, and his  team are incredibly knowledgeable and patient. They worked wonders with my pup lukas even when he might have not been at his best behavior while he was boarded with the care n love of Joey who greatly truly understood lukas behavior, as they became buddies with in no time.
Visible Progress with the training with Mike We've already seen huge improvements in specific commands, socialization, abd confidence thanks to the training sessions.
Boarding Experience:
Love & Safety: It's clear the staff genuinely loves dogs. They treated my munchkins like their own, ensuring their safety and happiness throughout their stay.
Cleanliness: The facility is clean, and my pups came back looking and smelling fantastic.
Communication: Mike and Joey went far and beyond with so many videos and photos they sent, which put my mind and heart at ease.
Overall:
Whitestone Dog House is a true gem. They are professional, attentive, and truly care about the well-being of the dogs. I highly recommend them for anyone looking for top-notch training and boarding services in the area. Our puppies are already looking forward to their next visit!
Thank you, Mike, Joey, and the whole team from the bottom of my heart.
Professional staff, very kind with the dogs 👌🏻🐕🦮🐕‍🦺🐩
We always look forward to seeing you and your pup and can't wait to see you again.
I don’t recommend this place and I’ll never bring my dog back again. On pickup day, the owner raised his arm near my dog. My dog ducked her head down quick. I knew she had been abused. Never again

My dog was poorly cared for and returned to me with loads of feces on his rear end, and his testicles irritated along with his tail you guys Discriminated my dog and said that he was too skinny because I do not feed him kibble. I cook for him twice a day salmon, chicken and broccoli and carrots.

My response to your unprofessionalism and uneducated facility

When I dropped him off, he had only minor matting. Upon pickup, not only was the matting significantly worse, but he also had feces matted around his rear, and noticeable irritation on his testicles and tail. This level of neglect is unacceptable from any professional grooming service.
Additionally, I am extremely concerned by your staff's comments regarding my dog’s weight and body condition. Accusing me of underfeeding him simply because I do not use kibble is both uninformed and discriminatory. I feed him a balanced, home-cooked diet that includes salmon, chicken, broccoli, and carrots twice a day. He is lean, healthy, and well cared for.
Your team’s inability or unwillingness to demat properly, followed by what I felt was a dismissive and unprofessional response, shows a lack of both skill and customer service. I was able to demat him myself at home without issue — and I am not a professional groomer.
My dog’s testicles were in healthy condition prior to his visit with you. The irritation he developed after being in your care is extremely concerning and warrants your immediate attention.
I expect accountability for the condition in which my dog was returned to me and a clear explanation of how such neglect occurred. I also expect a resolution — whether that be a refund, a written apology, or another appropriate form of acknowledgment and correction.
I hope you take this complaint seriously and implement better care standards going forward. I am happy to provide photos and veterinary notes if necessary.

My dog and cat are happy going in, so that tells me everything about the caliber of care they received. The staff really cares that whatever instructions I leave regarding my fur kids routines are followed. My two are my heart and this place gives me peace of mind when I travel. Peace of mind is everything.
AMAZING STAFF! Trust worthy and kind

The best groomers and bathers in Queens!!! My dog is always clean, shinny and fluffy after his bath and always enters/leaves the shop tail-wagging. Each member of this facility really pays attention to detail and tailors the needs of each pet’s and client’s to accommodate the services. Couldn’t recommend them any more!
Bianca does an amazing job with our doodle! He comes out cute every time and they have it noted down exactly what we like. We’ve been going since our dog was just a pup! Highly recommend

WSDH is my go to place when I need to board my dog. The staff is friendly and they take care of your dog's individual needs such as specific feeding instructions and medications  o requests for bubble play time. 😃 They have spacious kennels that are spread apart for non-social dogs who are boarding/ day care and group pens for social dogs who are using their doggy day care.  When you get your buddy back from them at the end of their stay they will be freshly bathed.
Been taking my dog moony here for years !They always give her the best cut. Super professional here!

12/20/24- This is my second time boarding Zina for a week I was sad to leave my baby but knew that Mike Chris and staff would take care of my baby I got videos everyday and Zina looked happy I was relieved but still miss my baby I appreciate you all and especially Joe you guys are the Very Best n Always go Above n Beyond!!! Thank You So Much For Taking Care of My Zina!! This is the only place I would leave my baby!! I Highly Recommend this place!!!!

This is the first time I left my baby  Zina in a boarding place but Mike made it easy for me and he said my baby is now his baby Mike N Chris sent me videos I was happy for that so I was comfortable n not worry I’m so happy that I chose Whitestone Doghouse a Clean and Safe Place they bathe my baby I give this place 10STARS your PET  will be SAFE  N HAPPY HERE!!! THANKS SO MUCH GOD BLESS YOU GUYS N STAFF until my next trip Kind Regards  Zaida n Zina
